description: Webapp kit — web development context with package.json

required.name: playwright
required.purpose: Browser automation for E2E testing and visual regression
required.installCmd: claude mcp add playwright -s user -- npx @playwright/mcp@latest --headless

recommended.name: t1k-web-testing-chrome-devtools
recommended.purpose: Browser DevTools for console, network, and performance analysis
recommended.installCmd: claude mcp add chrome-devtools -s user -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest
